summary: Controladora Vuela Compania de Aviacion, S.A.B. de C.V. (Volaris) filed a Form 6-K reporting routine monthly traffic results for June 2026. The press release discloses preliminary operational metrics such as a load factor of 83.6%, ASM capacity up 8.7%, and RPM growth of 8.4%, with 2.7 million passengers transported. There are no special-situation components: no M&A, capital return, restructuring, or board changes. The filing is a standard operational update under Rule 13a-16 for foreign private issuers. No deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation are mentioned. No further action expected.
